{{Quote|More like a landspeeder is devoted to the man behind the steering wheel!|[[FE-9Q]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>}}
A '''steering wheel''' was a type of control device installed inside vehicles such as [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and the [[Buick]]. [[Wheel]]-shaped in form, its function was to maneuver the craft left and right.
